⚙ BRICKWAY SETTINGS

Paused · Customize your driving experience
Audio starts after you interact with the game. Press M to mute at any time.
HUD layoutMove the on-screen controls and displays for this mode.

Controller: D-pad or left stick to navigate, A / Cross to select, B / Circle to go back. Start / Options pauses during a race.

Vibration testPlays a test pulse on your active controller.

These are the current controls. Drift note: hold W/↑ + SPACE while steering to kick out the rear and build drift combos in Open World. In F1, Space brakes; A/D steering is half sensitivity.

W↑ Accelerate
S↓ Brake / reverse
A← Steer left
D→ Steer right
W + SPACE + steer: Drift (Open World); SPACE: Brake (F1)
SHIFT Boost
R Reset car
M Mute / unmute
C Cycle camera
ENTER Start / stop race
ESC Open / close settings
Drag to moveA picks up / places · D-pad moves
